audience: teams that run servers, databases, DNS and storage on Vultr

useCases.title: Review what the account costs now
useCases.text: Show the charges that built up since the last invoice, grouped by resource. Then list the invoices with their status.

useCases.title: Check which instances run and what they use
useCases.text: List the cloud instances with their region, plan and IP address. Read the bandwidth one instance used in the last month.

useCases.title: Audit firewall rules before a change
useCases.text: List the firewall groups, then read the inbound rules of one group: protocol, port, subnet and action.

useCases.title: Check the DNS records of a domain
useCases.text: List the domains hosted on Vultr DNS, then read the records of one domain with their type and TTL.

useCases.title: Check the nodes of a Kubernetes cluster
useCases.text: List the Kubernetes clusters with their region, version and status. Then list the nodes of one cluster.
